summary: Quantum BioPharma filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing attendance at the ArcStone-Kingswood Growth Summit in Toronto on September 16, 2026, where Executive Co-chairman Anthony Durkacz will present recent milestones and growth strategy. The release highlights FDA approval of the Lucid-MS Investigational New Drug application to begin Phase 2 trials in progressive multiple sclerosis. No securities transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine investor-conference announcement, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
